column1: # The incidental-timing ratchet (surface/test/timing-lint.test.ts; patterns in surface/src/timing-lint.ts).
# One row per test file and pattern that depended on timing when the rule was made (2026-10-28, origin/main 4c1a6e5):
# the count of findings the check allows there. Rows only shrink. A fix lowers its row to the new count, or deletes it at
# zero, in the same commit; the check fails until it does. A new finding anywhere fails the check: wait on the real
# event or call the logic directly, or, when timing is the subject, drive it with a fake clock and mark it
# `// timing-under-test: <what> (fake clock: <name>)`. Sorted by file then pattern; one TAB between columns.
